name: Integrated Combat (Combat)
body:
Benefit(s): You gain a +1 bonus on attack rolls with implanted weapons. In addition, you gain a +2 bonus on all skill checks attempted as part of any martial maneuver made while wielding an implanted weapon.

Special: This bonus does not stack with the Weapon Focus feat, but counts as Weapon Focus with all implanted weapons for the purpose of meeting prerequisites.
